```plato

// A Porter-Duff alpha-compositing operator: how source and destination
// coverage combine. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alpha_compositing)
type PorterDuff
    = Clear
    | Source
    | Destination
    | SourceOver
    | DestinationOver
    | SourceIn
    | DestinationIn
    | SourceOut
    | DestinationOut
    | SourceAtop
    | DestinationAtop
    | Xor
    | Plus;
```
